qualification_gate.anchors: each chain consumes only its own verified predecessor anchor; chunk 0 is unanchored
qualification_gate.audio_residency: Same latent, unchanged BF16 audio VAE and vocoder, direct native xpu3 waveform equals xpu2 bytes on all three eager chunks; CPU reference unloaded before cone capture; all nine frozen/chain waveform and latent gates retained; streaming uses xpu2 with before/after workspace checks.
qualification_gate.aux_residency: Separate residency qualification identity bound to every receipt and verdict;145 must match frozen121 eager outputs;169 three chains and every chunk anchor bytes; floors unchanged.
qualification_gate.compare: per chunk, byte-identical across the eager chain, the graph chain and the graph repeat: the three latents (video, audio, stage A), the anchor file, and the decode thread's images and waveform; the four captured tensors are re-read from the capture files; mixed: the decoded frame each anchored stage B consumed equals its predecessor's decode record and capture last frame
qualification_gate.cone_graph_memory: Exactly forward_pre_diffusion in a decoder-private pool, guarded before capture and after growth; full card3 references on all nine qualification chunks; cross-card display plus per-chunk cone bytes; no floor reductions or eager fallback.
qualification_gate.cross_packet: frame anchor: the eager chain equals the packet-113 (49) / packet-114 frame (97) reference hashes byte for byte
qualification_gate.decode_overlap: the decode thread runs in all three chains; gated chunks (eager and graph chains) wait for their whole decode and drain it before the next gated request (no overlap, the controls); the repeat chain overlaps the next chunk (streaming form)
qualification_gate.decoder_graph: LTX_DECODER_GRAPH=1: eager chain = uncached eager decoder; graph chain = uncached eager decode AND graph decode of the same latents, byte-identical images; graph chain chunk 0 captures the two decoder graphs, nothing later captures; one signature per captured method; a failure latches and writes the decoder-graph latch
qualification_gate.decoder_pool: packet123: with a pool cap the graph chain chunk 0 captures exactly the methods it lists as captured; the capped method runs eagerly with the caches (byte-gated as before)
qualification_gate.diagnostic_only: slot-0 pin (latent: A and B; mixed: A), guide pin (guide frames before the crop), the sharpness profile, mixed frame wait
qualification_gate.display_replica: Optional xpu:2 display is off by default; native xpu:3 uncached eager reference on every chunk of all three qualification chains; per-chunk cone-last-frame equality; fail closed on mismatch or memory refusal.
qualification_gate.graph: eager chain observes zero routes; graph chain chunk 2 and the whole repeat chain capture nothing new; uniform <=8 signatures on the prompt thread; frozen afterwards
qualification_gate.levers: eager chain: anchor_decode full, native stage-A/B encodes on the prompt thread (the reference); graph chain: the launch levers plus their native counterparts on the same inputs (cone last frame == full last frame; precomputed stage-A/B conditioning == native conditioning, samples and mask byte for byte); repeat chain: the launch levers in the stream form; a lever failure latches and writes that lever's latch file
qualification_gate.on_failure: latch: the server refuses all streaming requests
qualification_gate.prompt_cut: chunk 2 of every chain changes the prompt on the same anchor chain
qualification_gate.snapshots: packet123: every qualification receipt lists its four-card snapshots in order, in the launch snapshot mode; with fingerprint every one ran the walk beside it and agreed (a disagreement latches and writes the snapshot latch)
qualification_gate.stream_form: the repeat chain uses the streaming graph form (no gate nodes)
